What is sourdough?

Sourdough is a naturally leavened bread made from flour, water, salt, and wild yeast.

How long does fermentation take?

Bulk fermentation typically runs 4-6 hours at 22°C, or 3-4 hours at 26°C.

Why is my crust pale?

A pale crust usually means the oven was too cool. Bake at 230°C for the first 20 minutes.
